mapper.select: SELECT A.MANAGER_ID, A.MANAGER_PASSWORD, A.MANAGER_NAME, A.USE_YN, A.PART_ID, B.PART_NM AS PART_NAME, A.ROLE_ID, A.MANAGER_EMAIL, A.MANAGER_TEL, A.LOCK_YN, A.EMP_NO, A.ROLE_GUBUN, A.MANAGER_POSITION, A.MANAGER_PIC, 'EMP' AS SYSTEMCODE_USECODE FROM tb_managerinfo A LEFT JOIN tb_partinfo B ON A.PART_ID = B.PART_ID WHERE A.MANAGER_ID = #{userId} AND A.MANAGER_PASSWORD = #{userPwd} AND A.MANAGER_STATUS = 'STATE_01' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.MANAGER_ID, A.MANAGER_PASSWORD, A.MANAGER_NAME, A.USE_YN, A.PART_ID, B.PART_NM AS PART_NAME, A.ROLE_ID, A.MANAGER_EMAIL, A.MANAGER_TEL, A.LOCK_YN, A.EMP_NO, A.ROLE_GUBUN, A.MANAGER_POSITION, A.MANAGER_PIC, 'EMP' AS SYSTEMCODE_USECODE FROM tb_managerinfo A LEFT JOIN tb_partinfo B ON A.PART_ID = B.PART_ID WHERE A.MANAGER_ID = #{resfreshToken} AND A.MANAGER_STATUS = 'STATE_01' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
